name: No Sorgulama (nosorgulama.com.tr)

search.notes: Per-number pages with user comments. Comments may include a commenter's name. Use the national format with a leading 0 and digits only, for example 05XXXXXXXXX.

steps: Enter full name, email and the number concerned.
Write a message asking for removal under KVKK Law No. 6698 and submit.
optout.notes: Türkçe özet. nosorgulama.com.tr iletişim formunda Profilim kaldırılsın seçeneğini seçerek kaldırma talebi gönderin. The site says messages are answered within 3 business days and removal requests get priority. Its KVKK notice says comments stay online unless a removal request is made. A different site, nosorgulama.com, uses a similar name.

verification_note: Contact page and KVKK notice loaded with HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21 and describe the Profilim kaldirilsin request.
